review: B014 finite metadata lifecycle follow-up plan
scope: Read-only code and current feature05 review; no implementation, clock access, user data access or GUI comparison performed.
alreadyImplemented: Four stored date/duration query values with absent/value/invalid distinction and exact 100ns precision.
HWP PID12/PID13 to standard HWPX CreatedDate/ModifiedDate, bounded exact raw OLE carrier for last print/duration and unknown properties.
Read-only date/duration information UI and Agent statistics context; strict stored-date preservation comparison.
Five editable summary strings with fingerprint CAS, undo/redo; document-scoped CAS history and full model-story counts.
actualRemaining: No automatic creation/modification timestamp lifecycle; stored-information module explicitly uses no wall clock and UI explicitly promises no automatic updates.
No current-session active editing duration accumulator or successful-save acknowledgement of consumed time.
No print-success timestamp transaction. Existing lastPrinted is stored original information only.
Hancom-equivalent statistics and editing-time policy are unverified and remain separate from implemented exact model-story counting.

smallestImplementationSlices.name: Typed metadata transaction in isolated sibling Rust module
smallestImplementationSlices.change: Add checked prepare/apply system metadata transaction with expected original owner token, explicit created/modified/lastPrinted/duration fields as u64 decimal strings, and no internal clock. Reuse Ole parse/write and raw-span XML namespace writer. Update only standard CreatedDate/ModifiedDate plus OLE PID12/13, PID11 only actual print success, PID10 only acknowledged accumulated duration; preserve all other bytes/unknown properties. Invalid/duplicate/malformed original values remain refusal, never absent/zero. Start with pure native setter/clone transaction tests, not autosave wiring.

smallestImplementationSlices.name: Session clock and exact operation owner
smallestImplementationSlices.change: Inject wall UTC ticks only for explicit creation/save/print transactions, and a monotonic clock for bounded active-edit intervals. Scope session accounting by document instance and window; detect clock rollback, disallow negative elapsed, exclude hidden/background/sleep intervals by an explicit documented policy. Inherit exact original duration without rounding. Do not infer Hancom-equivalent policy before deferred comparison.

smallestImplementationSlices.name: Strict save-snapshot and acknowledgement integration
locations: current patched payload/export producer (locate exact build injection before editing)
smallestImplementationSlices.change: Prepare timestamped export clone and compare emitted bytes against that exact expected clone using unchanged preservation guard. Keep live original owner unchanged through picker/cancel/CAS failure and partial write/readback failure. After acknowledged disk readback and exact document instance/revision, commit only the corresponding metadata receipt and consumed duration once; preserve elapsed time accrued after snapshot. Ordinary exports/preflight/recovery/downloads without disk acknowledgement must not consume elapsed time or advance saved clock. Do not omit stored-date evidence or relax equality to allow timestamp changes. Agent bound-save and UI save must share the transaction.

smallestImplementationSlices.name: History and recovery separation
locations: existing snapshot history and recovery boundaries
smallestImplementationSlices.change: Define automatic saved audit values separately from user-edit undo snapshots so undo/redo does not roll back an acknowledged lastSaved/elapsed receipt or double-count time. Recovery must restore unacknowledged elapsed information only under the same document owner and cannot claim a successful disk save. Expose original stored time and pending session time distinctly until acknowledged.

boundedAcceptanceCases: New explicit document establishes creation once; imported document does not manufacture missing creation.
Read-only open and query/export alone change no stored time.
Editing then real successful HWP save updates modified and duration exactly.
Same successful HWPX save updates canonical metadata owner and reverse HWP PID12/13 exactly.
Last print unchanged without successful print receipt.
Repeated save without new elapsed interval does not double-count.
Picker cancellation preserves live metadata and pending elapsed.
CAS refusal preserves metadata and pending elapsed.
Write or close failure does not acknowledge time.
Post-close readback mismatch does not acknowledge time.
Acknowledgement with changed instance/revision rejected.
Two simultaneous save attempts cannot consume same interval twice.
Two documents/windows do not share elapsed ownership.
Clock rollback does not subtract duration.
Hidden/suspend intervals obey stated policy.
Duration overflow rejected, original 100ns fractional precision retained.
Malformed OLE/duplicate XML/unknown attributes remain unchanged or rejected.
Unknown OLE properties/carrier binding preserved with exact standard values.
Undo/redo after acknowledged save does not roll back audit receipt.
Recovery restores pending interval without falsely marking disk saved.
completionWarning: This plan does not mark B014 complete. Stored-original read-only preservation is already implemented; lifecycle mutation and Hancom-equivalent policy are actual remaining scope. Preserve their independent status.
